'''August 1999 Mastic tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mastic, NY on 29 August 1999. [[Tony Garcia]] won it. It is known from Tony Garcia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d27">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-01-mastic-ny-8-29-99d27/ mastic-ny-8-29-99], DeckTech (Tony "Don Fat Tony" Garcia, 1 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-01-mastic-ny-8-29-99d27/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Mastic, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Tony Garcia]]
